purpose: Validate the shape and scope of an externally established authorization record; this helper does not authenticate its issuer or expiry.
trigger: Use before any desktop control when the task scope or authorization record may have changed.

inputs.name: authorization
inputs.description: Trusted caller record with authorized=true and scope; optional run_ref. JSON does not establish real consent.

inputs.name: task_scope
inputs.description: Requested scope subset to check, default None.

preconditions: Caller must verify issuer, expiry, revocation and actual run authorization before calling. The helper checks authorized=true, scope subset and optional run_ref only.
Caller has established the actual run scope and trustworthy input provenance.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed; EX13 returns blocked/eligible and ER11 quarantined/deleted.

outputs.name: authorized_by_caller
outputs.description: True; consent must have been established externally.

postconditions: Validate the shape and scope of an externally established authorization record; this helper does not authenticate its issuer or expiry.
Only the declared flat result fields are returned; no desktop or unperformed persistence layer is implied.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: Call confirm_control_authorization(**payload), or dispatch("EX-01", payload). Rejected inputs raise HostActionError (with code); filesystem failures may propagate OSError. Caller must verify issuer, expiry, revocation and actual run authorization before calling. The helper checks authorized=true, scope subset and optional run_ref only. The linked guide uses conceptual fields; explicitly adapt them to this canonical function interface, never dispatch the guide output directly.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: No traceable authorization covers the requested control.
failure_modes.detection: Issuer, scope, or validity is absent or does not match task_scope.
failure_modes.safe_state: No desktop or file action has started.

failure_modes.condition: The record contains conflicting scope or time information.
failure_modes.detection: Records disagree or the effective interval cannot be resolved.
failure_modes.safe_state: Remain stopped and preserve both records.

recovery.action: Obtain explicit authorization covering the exact application/actions, then reevaluate.
Return needs_manual_review and ask for one authoritative scope.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
